args.prompt:
SPEC WRITING ONLY. Do NOT implement, edit source code, run cargo, build, test, or deploy anything. Only write /srv/git/odbus-verified/.kiro/specs/ai-sdk-door-adapter/requirements.md. The .config.kiro already exists; do not recreate it. WRITE THE FILE EARLY: draft requirements.md first from the request below, then do only light verification (AGENTS.md, last six entries of /srv/git/odbus-verified/HANDOFF.md, a quick grep confirming the named symbols/files exist) and refine. No deep research.

Spec type: New Feature. Workflow: Requirements-first. Feature name: ai-sdk-door-adapter. Write requirements.md in EARS form.

Owner's request (verbatim):

Problem. Chat in the 3tched UI (SvelteKit, @ai-sdk/svelte, repo /srv/git/3tched.com) has no working reply path:
- chat_response.submit_turn waits for a responder agent that doesn't exist, so every message times out with "unknown outcome".
- The demo uses chat_router.Chat, which records a mutation per message.

Target design:
- The Vercel AI SDK talks to the 8090 door, and the SDK itself receives the reply.
- The door (tonic and bridge) translates the SDK's HTTP chat protocol into one admitted plugin call, threetched.agent, going through sealed-blob schema validation, identity grants and D-Bus, ending in a receipt.
- The bridge records one mutation, when the call completes.

Requirements
1. New route on the existing 8090 router accepting the AI SDK chat request (POST, JSON { id, messages: UIMessage[], provider, model }), beside /mqtt in crates/op-grpc-bridge/src/server.rs. No new port, no new service.
2. Identity only from existing door headers: exactly one of OIA1 (x-oracle-identity-assertion-bin) or SID1 (SEALED_ID_METADATA_KEY, interceptor.rs). Verify via the interceptor's existing path. No/bad credential -> 401/403 with zero dispatch. Never mint identity.
3. Dispatch exactly one call per message: MutationEngine::dispatch_method_call_with_identity("threetched", "agent", args, Some(cap), principal, session, genesis) — same dispatcher as gRPC PluginService/CallMethod and the 3tchedFS lungs socket. Capability: cap.software.threetched.call.cd4f0bc5a29de06b510f9aa428f1eedba926012b591fef7a518e776a7c9bd1824@v1. Argument schema from sealed blob /dev/shm/opdbus/plugin-blobs/threetched.*.blob (fields include --message, --model-provider, --model, --session-state-file).
4. Response: AI SDK UI-message stream, text/event-stream, header x-vercel-ai-ui-message-stream: v1. SSE chunks start, text-start, text-delta..., text-end, finish, [DONE]. Errors as an error chunk with a user-safe message.
5. Client disconnect cancels the dispatch, following crates/op-grpc-bridge/src/chat_service.rs send().
6. One mutation per message using the admitted call's own commit/receipt. Never call chat_response.submit_turn or respond_to_user on this path.
7. UI: src/svelte/session-chat-transport.ts uses DefaultChatTransport pointed at the route, with door identity headers and { provider, model } from the confirmed route (demo: openrouter / meta/muse-spark-1.3, RuntimeHost.svelte DEMO_ROUTE). On the 8080 page, use op-web's same-origin connector if direct TLS to 8090 fails (sameOriginDoorUrl in src/grpc/door.ts). Then remove the demo chat_router.Chat call from src/chat/door-chat-adapter.ts submit() (commit 5a935be).

Constraints (non-negotiable)
- Translate the protocol; never relay bytes. No proxy to threetched's gateway 127.0.0.1:8084 (raw /threetched relay reverted in c86871c for bypassing D-Bus, admission and 3tchedFS).
- D-Bus is the only control plane. Sealed blob is the only schema. No MCP, no new schema files.
- Rust only (no new Python). One Cargo process at a time. Tests/clippy only on owner request.
- Grants are owner-approved. Identity c9bdf32e-811d-2495-b688-277c9e5c4d36 lacks the capability. Spec must include the exact grant change for owner approval, not apply it: (a) back up /etc/opdbus/capability-grants.json; (b) jq the capability into that identity's .capabilities; (c) sv restart opdbus-grants; (d) cmp the file against /dev/shm/opdbus/capability-grants.json.
- Deploy only via ./activate-golden.sh with OP_PERSISTED_CATALOG_SOURCE=/var/tmp/release-catalog-20261101-b (or a fresh opblob seal-plugins catalog if schema changes), run detached with a receipt file.

Build notes (for design later): bridge built in a private mount namespace bind-mounting an empty dir over /var/lib/tched-router; template /tmp/claude-1000/-srv-git-odbus-verified/f8e7bf68-1189-4b28-9e1a-074672aaaba6/scratchpad/bridge-release.sh. No schema change: cargo build --release -p op-grpc-bridge. Schema change: workspace build; cargo build --release -p op-deployment --bin op-release (must byte-match /usr/local/libexec/opdbus-release/op-release); opblob seal-plugins refusing if any plugin would be removed.

Acceptance criteria
- Authenticated AI SDK request over 8090 streams text-delta chunks and ends with finish.
- Unauthenticated request gets 401, no dispatch in bridge log.
- Bridge log shows exactly one admitted threetched/agent call per message.
- http://10.0.0.2:8080 shows the reply in the chat panel.
- Demo chat_router.Chat path removed.
- HANDOFF.md entry with commits, release id, evidence, and what was not verified.

Produce requirements.md only.
